# Autonomous Entanglement Noise Floor

This repository studies the stationary fidelity and operational mixing limits
of fixed Markovian entanglement stabilization with local-sum jump operators.
The complete scientific account is organized by topic under science/.

Canonical entrypoints:
- README.md: physical question, sharp qubit noise law, scientific reading
  routes, assumptions, reproduction command and purpose/contact.
- science/model.md: authoritative generator, fidelity, strength and mixing
  conventions; exact statements R1--R4 and their domains.
- science/rigidity.md: dominant-eigenvector control, explicit jump-centering
  gauge, inherited spectral balance and maximally entangled transpose identity,
  quadratic outgoing variance, arbitrary-H block control and adjoint bound.
- science/noise_floor.md: independent dephasing converse, fixed bounded
  local-noise variance corollary, and matching qubit asymptotic exponent.
- science/mixing.md: all-input half-trace-distance convention, orthogonal
  product witness, observable-speed proof and degenerate endpoints.
- science/attaining_reservoir.md: inherited squeezed-pair family, jump norms,
  pure-state population evolution, exact noisy state, uniqueness/convergence,
  exact family optimization and transport to any Bell target.
- science/interpretation.md: stationary repair-flux mechanism, coherent
  control, physical budget normalization, architecture changes, experimental
  motivation and remaining quantitative refinements.
- references/RELATED_WORK.md: source-level attribution and model comparisons.
- references/references.bib: primary bibliographic metadata.
- learning/RIVAS_HUELGA_BRIDGE.md: the single educational anchor,
  Rivas--Huelga, Open Quantum Systems: An Introduction (2012), using
  arXiv:1104.5242v2 section numbering; notation and assumptions translated
  into the stationary-flow proof and the exact two-qubit example.
- learning/MILESTONES.md: exactly 30 common, project-defined understanding
  milestones, ordered from foundations to the complete scientific narrative.
- verification/README.md: actual finite checks, commands and their limits.
- verification/verify_reservoir.py: reproducible verification entrypoint.

Reader routes:
- To understand the physical result, read model.md, noise_floor.md and
  interpretation.md; use the exact reservoir as a worked example.
- To inspect the universal proof, read model.md and rigidity.md, then the
  noise-floor or mixing consequence. Use the full proof and source attribution.
- To inspect attainability, read attaining_reservoir.md and the verification
  guide; distinguish the globally optimal exponent from a family coefficient.
- To reproduce calculations, follow verification/README.md. Distinguish a
  command actually executed from committed historical outputs.
- To learn the project, use learning/MILESTONES.md with the Rivas--Huelga
  bridge. The map is independent of any reader's progress; distinguish
  textbook foundations, inherited research ingredients and local derivations.

Essential distinctions:
- J=A tensor I+I tensor B is a condition on effective jumps; microscopic local
  bath coupling does not automatically imply it after elimination.
- H is unrestricted but time independent. After centering the jumps, the
  proof bounds the corresponding block of the gauge-adjusted H_c; it does
  not necessarily bound that block of the original supplied H separately.
- K is the declared sum of squared jump operator norms. Gamma counts only
  engineering; the independent dephaser contributes kappa to total K.
- D[J](rho)=J rho J-dagger - {J-dagger J,rho}/2. With this convention,
  kappa D[Z_A] damps opposite-Z coherences at rate 2 kappa.
- epsilon is Bell/full-maximal-target infidelity, not stationary impurity.
- R1 and R2 apply to complete equal local factors in any finite d>=2.
- R3's traceless-unitary dephasing version requires even d; its explicit
  sharp attaining example and R4 optimize two-qubit Bell stabilization.
- The target-variance corollary for other noise is a lower bound. Matching
  performance for every such operator is not claimed.
- The optimized squeezed-family coefficient sqrt(3) is not established as
  the global optimum. The global result is the square-root order.
- The mixing accuracy 1/4 is half trace distance to the actual stationary
  state, uniformly over inputs. It is not target infidelity epsilon.
- No universal dissipative-gap claim follows by taking a reciprocal mixing
  time; normality and detailed balance are not assumed.
- Retained auxiliary systems, subspace Bell targets and adaptive/switching
  dynamics are distinct architectures, with known examples in prior work.
- Spectral balance, the transpose identity and the reservoir family are
  inherited. Read RELATED_WORK.md before making originality claims.
- Finite verification supports explicit algebra and instances; universal
  statements are supported by the written arguments and cited ingredients.
